partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-001: Bundles named *.clap are not VST3 or VST2 candidates in any folder
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-002: Two independent switches per format; VST3 and VST2 system folders; custom folder only with its switch on and a folder set; both off gives no candidates; no other folder searched; a missing folder contributes nothing; order not specified
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-004: VST3 candidates: entries at any depth whose name ends exactly in .vst3, directories and plain files; candidates not searched inside; every other directory searched
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-005: VST2 candidates: directories at any depth whose name ends in .vst in any ASCII letter case; not searched inside; every other directory searched, including *.vst3; plain files never; unreadable directories skipped and the search continues

inputs_without_expectation: symbolic links anywhere in a tree or in a folder path; entries other than directories and plain files
names or folder paths with characters other than ASCII letters, digits, space, hyphen, underscore, period and the path separator, including a comma; names beginning with a period
custom folders that are not absolute or that end with a separator; folder paths that name a plain file
paths longer than 255 bytes once ~ is expanded
permissions other than the description form (normal access, or mode 000 on a directory as allowed)
in a VST3 folder, any directory that cannot be read; any permission change on an entry whose name ends in .vst3 or .vst in any letter case
folders of one format that are equal or nested, including a custom folder at or below a system folder of its format
more than 50 candidates of one format
a home folder other than the account's own, including a different HOME environment value; stored letter case of a folder path that differs from this release
trees changed while a scan runs
behavior: examination order, including any order between the formats and between folders (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-003)
what a candidate contributes: listing, names, instrument or effect, code signatures, entry points (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-006, 007)
later scans: unchanged, changed, removed and returning modules; Rescan and its reset variant; quitting during a scan (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-008 to 010, 016)
crashing and hanging modules, more than 50 new modules, duplicates (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-012 to 015)
Audio Unit discovery; process isolation; activation of plug-in sources (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-001 remainder)
control labels, defaults, effects of changing a switch or custom folder, when scans start, custom folders containing a comma (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-002 remainder)
symbolic links and unreadable subfolders in VST3 folders; the folder structure presented to the user (REQ-PLUGIN-DISCOVERY-004, 005 remainder)

fixture_origin: independently authored scenario descriptions (settings and a tree of empty placeholder directories and empty files); no plug-in, executable, bundle content or shipped file

reviewers: separate review agent (Claude Opus 5.5) in a coordinator-launched handoff-review context; not the author; will not implement

RVP-03 info: candidate set ruled observable for directory entries; open application-side discovery items are excluded or concern only how a probe starts a scan
RVP-04 low: plain-file candidacy has no established reference observation; obligation 4 now names cases 021 (J.vst3) and 028; expectations unchanged
RVP-05 info: the author's seven proposed draft corrections confirmed; none leaks into the payload
RVP-06 info: three assumptions confirmed by the reviewer's reading, two accepted as stated assumptions; no expectation invented or changed
RVP-07 info: 20 new cases, the candidate-set representation and the subset's usefulness accepted
RVP-08 editorial: payload status wording set to reviewed release; review record added; inventory re-hashed
RVP-09 info: evidence identity re-checked on 2026-10-18; all hashes matched
RVP-10 info: sharing review of folder paths and invented names; acceptable
review.disposition: Approved with listed clarifications (RVP-01, RVP-02, RVP-04), only for the explicit partial clauses; no scope narrowed; expectations static-derived; reference and candidate execution not-run; restricted implementation workspace required
